faqs.q: Do you handle permits for bathtub installations in Buffalo?
faqs.a: Yes, we handle all necessary permits and ensure installations meet Buffalo building codes and regulations.

faqs.q: What types of bathtubs do you install?

faqs.q: Do you offer warranties on bathtub installations?
